name: gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-4, gpt-4-turbo and o1 are shut down; move to GPT-5.6
gain: OpenAI shut these down on 23 Oct 2026, so a request to one of them no longer works.
how: Follow the page per id: gpt-3.5-turbo and o4-mini to gpt-5.6-terra; gpt-4, gpt-4-turbo, o1 and o3-mini to gpt-5.6-sol; gpt-4.1-nano to gpt-5.6-luna. A model list in a picker can simply drop the entry.
replaces: gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-4, gpt-4-turbo, gpt-4.1-nano, o1, o1-pro, o3-mini, o4-mini and their dated snapshots
trade_offs: gpt-5.6-terra costs more than gpt-3.5-turbo: $2 / $12 against $0.50 / $1.50 per 1M tokens on OpenAI's price list.
The page covers OpenAI's own API, so check who the code calls: a gateway or a compatible server has its own list.
needs: Nothing new; the same OpenAI key.
